option_relations.rationale: Chronic anterior blepharitis is a general condition and does not specifically relate to the provided leaf
TNF-α inhibitor-induced psoriasiform dermatitis is a broader condition and does not specifically match the provided leaf
TNF-α inhibitor–induced psoriasiform blepharitis is a specific type of blepharitis that could be related to infliximab-induced blepharitis
Drug-induced blepharitis and ectropion associated with TNF-α inhibitors (infliximab and adalimumab) closely matches the description of infliximab-induced blepharitis
